value.title: Maharashtra
value.summary: Maharashtra (Marathi: महाराष्ट्र Mahārāshṭra) in Western India is the third-largest state of India by size and the second-largest by population. It stretches from the west coast to the interior regions with a variable climate. Maharashtra contains India's most industrialised region, the Mumbai-Pune belt. Agriculturally, too, the state is one of India's more advanced and well-ir...
eat_highlights: Vada pav: Popular Maharashtrian dish consisting of fried mashed-potato dumpling (vada), eaten sandwiched in a bun (pav). This is referred to as Indian version of burger and is almost always accompanied with the famous red chutney made from garlic and chillies, and fried green chillies. Interestingly rarly vada pav are home made. Very famous in Mumbai.
Chivda: Spiced flattened rice. It is also known as Bombay mix in Foreign countries especially Great Britain.
transit_modes: Indian Railways remains the backbone of long‑distance travel, with major junctions such as Mumbai CST, Mumbai Central, Pune, Nashik Road, Nagpur, Aurangabad, and Kolhapur offering frequent express and passenger trains to both intra‑state and national destinations.

State‑run MSRTC buses provide reliable coverage, ranging from basic red ST buses to more comfortable Shivneri and Ashwamedh air‑conditioned coaches on popular routes like Mumbai–Pune, Pune–Nashik, and Mumbai–Aurangabad. Private bus operators also run overnight sleeper services connecting major cities with smaller towns.

parsed_activities.name: Trek the Sahyadris
parsed_activities.desc: Popular routes include Rajmachi, Harishchandragad, Torna, Sinhagad, Kalsubai, and the forts of Shivaji’s era.

parsed_activities.name: Explore the Western Ghats
parsed_activities.desc: Waterfalls, dense forests, and monsoon landscapes around Lonavala, Matheran, Mahabaleshwar, and Amboli.

parsed_activities.name: Visit wildlife sanctuaries
parsed_activities.desc: Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve, Pench (Maharashtra side), Navegaon-Nagzira, and Karnala Bird Sanctuary

parsed_activities.name: Relax on Konkan beaches
parsed_activities.desc: Tarkarli, Ganpatipule, Diveagar, Harihareshwar, and Vengurla offer quieter alternatives to Goa.

parsed_activities.name: Tour ancient cave complexes
parsed_activities.desc: Ajanta, Ellora, Elephanta, and Karla–Bhaja caves.

parsed_activities.name: Visit historic forts
parsed_activities.desc: Raigad, Pratapgad, Sindhudurg, Daulatabad, Panhala and Murud-Janjira.

parsed_activities.name: Experience pilgrimage sites
parsed_activities.desc: Shirdi, Pandharpur, Trimbakeshwar, Bhimashankar, and the Ashtavinayak temples.

parsed_activities.name: Explore colonial-era architecture
parsed_activities.desc: South Mumbai’s Victorian buildings, Pune’s old cantonment, and Nagpur’s heritage quarters.

parsed_activities.name: Scuba diving and snorkelling
parsed_activities.desc: Tarkarli and Malvan offer clear waters and coral patches.

parsed_activities.name: Paragliding
parsed_activities.desc: Kamshet is one of India’s top paragliding hubs.

parsed_activities.name: Boating
parsed_activities.desc: Venna Lake (Mahabaleshwar), Rankala Lake (Kolhapur), and backwaters in Konkan.

parsed_activities.name: Camping
parsed_activities.desc: Pawna Lake, Bhandardara, and coastal campsites.
